Upper values $60,90,110,140,180,240$; cumulative frequencies $4,12,26,51,58,60$. B1 All cumulative frequencies stated; may be under the data table, condone omission of 4; if read from graph, must include 4. M1 At least 5 points plotted at class upper endpoints, within daylight-rule tolerance; linear cumulative-frequency scale $0\leq cf\leq60$ and linear time scale $30\leq x\leq240$, with at least 3 values identified on each axis. A1 All points plotted correctly; curve drawn within tolerance, with no ruled segments, and joined to $(30,0)$; axes labelled cumulative frequency and hours of sunshine (or equivalent, including an appropriate title). Total 3.

parts.label: (c)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Midpoints $45,75,100,125,160,210$. B1 At least 5 correct midpoints seen, checked from the data table or used in the formula. M1 Correct mean formula using their 6 midpoints (each within its class, not a class boundary), condoning 1 data error: $\frac{4(45)+8(75)+14(100)+25(125)+7(160)+2(210)}{60}=\frac{6845}{60}$. A1 $114$, $114\frac1{12}$; accept $114.1$ or $114.08[3\ldots]$. If A1 is not awarded, SC B1 for one of these correct answers. Total 3.
